protocol.condition_order: Rotate fixed3 condition list by SHA256(scene) modulo3; one single question per generation, never rerun/tune
protocol.blank: torch.zeros_like decoded original10frame video tensor before processor; original metadata/geometry/timestamps unchanged. Counterfactual input only, no generated video/quality label.
protocol.question_scope: All original8 reference scene questions; rejected candidate is not rescored/imputed. Same original prompt/model/decoding. Groundtruth labels do not enter prompts, controls receive no quality accuracy score.
protocol.decision_rule: Any invalid => INCONCLUSIVE_PARSE_INVALID; matched_repeat parsed changes => REPEAT_INSTABILITY_IN_SCOPE; either blank or mismatch zero parsed changes => CONTENT_INSENSITIVITY_SUSPECT_IN_SCOPE; else REPEAT_STABLE_AND_RESPONDS_TO_CONTENT_NOT_PHYSICAL_VALIDITY
protocol.scope: Registered after method proxy result, not blind/independent confirmation. Repeat/content sensitivity only; not physical accuracy/gold quality/235B Joint/method acceptance or prompt/parameter tuning.

summary.scope: All original8/42 questions x3 input conditions. Comparisons are response changes against original WC judge answers, not counterfactual quality accuracy, physical truth, independent confirmation or method acceptance.
